thread:
anas: Hey team — noticed a cluster of orgs showing $0 and NaN in the Token Cost dashboard since the daily aggregation run at 00:00 UTC. Sample orgs: org_8921, org_2319, org_9987. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
kevin: I see the preview in staging too. Looks like per-route breakdown shows NaN but total tokens looks present.
mika: Can you paste the query you ran? trying to repro locally.
anas: Sure — I ran the dashboard aggregation SQL that calculates cost = tokens * price_per_token. Simple repro snippet:```SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens) as t, AVG(price_per_token) as p, SUM(tokens) * AVG(price_per_token) as cost FROM token_metering WHERE day = '2026-02-28' GROUP BY org_id;``` For some orgs p is NULL so cost comes out NULL/NaN and our UI shows $0 for presentation.
lucy: That AVG(price_per_token) being NULL is suspicious — why would price be null? reserved capacity orgs?
chris_billing: Those orgs are on reserved capacity + custom pricing (legacy rows). There are some metering events missing the pricing key. We recently changed where price_per_token is populated in the ingestion pipeline.
kevin: In the aggregation job we used multiplication with AVG(price_per_token) — if price_per_token missing then cost becomes NULL. Our frontend maps null -> $0 in the widget. Bad UX. We should coalesce in SQL.
mika: Agree. Quick mitigation: coalesce price to the fallback price from pricing_lookup table. Example fix:```SELECT m.org_id, SUM(tokens) as t, COALESCE(AVG(m.price_per_token), pl.default_price) as p, SUM(tokens) * COALESCE(AVG(m.price_per_token), pl.default_price) as cost FROM token_metering m LEFT JOIN pricing_lookup pl ON m.org_id = pl.org_id WHERE day='2026-02-28' GROUP BY m.org_id, pl.default_price;```
anas: Will that handle orgs with no pricing row? pl.default_price may also be NULL for some legacy accounts.
chris_billing: We have a global default price at 0.0001 token/cent in pricing_lookup.default where org not found. But the lookup job that materializes pricing_lookup failed for a subset between 23:00-23:30 UTC. That explains the holes.
lucy: Ok so root cause: pricing_lookup backfill didn't run for a subset of orgs and aggregation ran after that, producing NULLs -> UI shows $0/NaN.
kevin: Proposed quick fixes: 1) update aggregation to COALESCE price with global default 2) re-run aggregation for affected day(s) 3) add alert when price_per_token is NULL on more than X orgs.
mika: I can open a PR for the SQL change and add a safety COALESCE on the compute side.
anas: Meanwhile, is there a way to patch the dashboard so it doesn't show $0 which triggers customer tickets? Maybe show "Data delayed" state.
kevin: Frontend already has a flag for incomplete rows. We need to set that when cost is NULL. Small UI change.
anas: Can someone run a quick ad-hoc query to list affected orgs and their reserved flag?```SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens, COUNT(price_per_token) as price_samples, AVG(COALESCE(price_per_token,0)) as avg_price FROM token_metering WHERE day='2026-02-28' GROUP BY org_id HAVING COUNT(price_per_token)=0 OR AVG(COALESCE(price_per_token,0))=0;```
chris_billing: Running now... results: org_8921 (reserved), org_2319 (reserved), org_9987 (standard), org_4452 (legacy). I'll DM CSV to support.
anas: Thanks. I'll notify the affected customers with a brief note that metrics are delayed and we are reprocessing.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-245 • token-cost-null-values — assigned to @kevin and @chris_billing • priority P2
kevin: I'll take compute changes and re-run job. Mika please review PR.
mika: Will do. ETA for PR review 1h.
kevin: Re-run started: `./run_aggregator --day 2026-02-28 --force-recompute --use-pricing-fallback`
lucy: Watching logs — aggregator warnings show ~120 orgs with missing pricing entries.
chris_billing: Follow-up: found root issue in pricing ETL where a partition upload failed on 2026-02-27 23:12 UTC. Fixing that now and re-running pricing backfill.
anan: (typo) — anas: thanks.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: aggregator v2.14.1 (includes COALESCE fix). CI passed.
kevin: Deployed aggregator v2.14.1 to prod at 2026-02-28T02:15:43Z. Recompute finished.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-245 status: mitigated — recompute complete, pricing backfill in progress.
mika: I verified counts post-recompute: previously NaN/org showed cost populated now. Sample diff: org_8921 cost went from NULL -> $134.52.
anas: Customer updates sent, dropped churn risk tag.
chris_billing: We'll keep a follow-up to add a nightly validation to ensure pricing_lookup coverage > 99.5% before aggregation.
lucy: Also adding a UI guard: show "Data incomplete — retry in ~15m" instead of $0 for NULL cost. I'll open a small frontend PR.
anas: Great. Closing loop: cause = pricing backfill partition failure -> NULL price used in aggregation -> SQL produced NULL cost -> UI mapped to $0/NaN -> customer confusion. Fixes = code-level COALESCE, recompute, pricing backfill, alerts + UI guard.
kevin: Adding postmortem note to #postmortems later today. :memo:
anas: Thanks everyone. I'll mark thread resolved once customers ack.
chris_billing: Customer replies already — all good. Closing. :white_check_mark:
